rules: No dialogue for now. Music and sound only.
No big simulations: no destruction, fluids, smoke, hair or particle effects.
Suitable for everyone: no sexual content, no graphic violence or gore.
No hate, harassment or discrimination of any kind.
Your own work only. No AI generated art, no copyrighted characters, brands or real people.
A small world: a few characters and a few places, so the crowd can build it.
